mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_balance_movement (movement_no, account_id, settlement_customer_id, customer_id, type, direction, amount, source_type, source_id, reason, occurred_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{movementNo}, #{accountId}, #{settlementCustomerId}, #{customerId}, #{type}, #{direction}, #{amount}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{reason}, #{occurredAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}) ON CONFLICT (source_type, source_id) WHERE deleted = FALSE AND source_type IS NOT NULL DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction = #{credit} THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 0) FROM customer_balance_movement WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND deleted = FALSE
SELECT * FROM customer_balance_movement WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND deleted = FALSE ORDER BY occurred_at, id
